methods: FD001: one operating condition and one fault mode. FD003: one condition and two fault modes.
60 whole engines select model parameters; 20 validation engines choose Ridge or gradient boosting. Refit on those 80 engines.
20 separate calibration engines provide one randomly censored snapshot each for a nominal 90% split-conformal interval.
Official test engines are used only for final evaluation; their integer IDs are partition-local and do not denote the training engines.
Each feature uses only the current or earlier cycles of its own engine. Current sensors, trailing 10-cycle mean, and trailing delta accompany cycle count.
Training RUL targets and predictions are capped at 125 cycles. Reported test errors and interval coverage use uncapped official truth.
Age-only baseline: median training-engine lifetime minus observed cycles, clipped at zero.
The interval is calibrated on random training truncations; official-test truncations may differ. Measured coverage is reported, not guaranteed.
This is an offline benchmark. Browser replay displays stored predictions; it does not train a model or diagnose operational aircraft.
